_about: A weapon's refinement passive for the formula estimate (math-fallback P3, task 12). Every number is read from the seeded `weapon_refinements.param_list` of the wielder's refinement by index ({"param": i}); `pins` holds each refinement's list as curated, and a wielder whose list differs is withheld rather than read by a stale index. Structure is transcribed from Genshin Optimizer's WR weapon sheet `go` at `go_commit` (MIT), lines per effect; gcsim's implementation at `gcsim_commit` where it has one. Validated by app/formula/genshin/weapon_passives.py.

conditions.label: Vatsamonga's Vatic Vintage stacks (after the wielder heals)
After a party Frozen or Stellar Swirl reaction (5s)

usual.reason: Off: needs a party Frozen reaction, which depends on the team; the estimate does not check it

effects.label: After Frozen: 75% more Max HP% per stack
The active character's ATK% per 1,000 of the wielder's Max HP over 40,000, per stack

unmodelled.what: After Frozen: 75% more of the active character's ATK%
unmodelled.reason: its cap is 75% of the listed cap, a product of two parameters the file's cap cannot carry

unmodelled.what: the stacks' own Max HP% in the HP the ATK% reads
unmodelled.reason: only the weapon's unconditional stats enter what its values read; past the cap it is moot
